decision: We will build own chunk endpoints over the StorageBackend seam instead of wrapping Supabase TUS, so no storage credential reaches the browser and each session stays bound to one org and prefix.
options_considered: Owner delegated this choice in the brief (2026-11-13: decide TUS vs own, record it). TUS needs a user JWT or service key at the client and scopes by bucket policy, not per session; signed upload URLs are single-PUT, not resumable. Own endpoints keep resume state server-side and work on Fake/Local backends.
